    toc: false
---

Two linked views of the whole corpus. On the **left**, every iGEM project, paper, and patent sits in
the shared semantic space, coloured by type, with the larger topic clusters labelled. On the
**right**, the same artifacts are aggregated by city on a world map. The panels talk to each other:
click a point in the semantic space to pin an artifact and find its city on the map, or click a city
on the map to light up everything it contributed in the semantic space. Use the toggles to show or
hide each artifact type. Carbon-capture artifacts carry a red badge.

```{=html}
<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.27.0.min.js"></script>
<div id="explorer-app"></div>
<script src="assets/js/explorer.js"></script>
```
